Best Fishing

Saltwater flats, blue-water grounds and trout and salmon rivers — the places worth building a trip around, and what each one actually holds. Almost every fishery here is a season rather than a destination: a marlin ground is a three-month window, a salmon river runs on the water level, and the flats that read best on a map are the ones that need a spring tide to fish at all.

Junín de los Andes
Neuquén
Chimehuín and Malleo RiversDry-Fly Water
A Patagonian town at the junction of the Chimehuín, Malleo and Aluminé rivers, with wadeable freestone water for rainbow and brown trout under the Lanín volcano. The dragonfly hatch in late summer is the local set piece.
Wikipedia Map
Río Grande
Tierra del Fuego
Sea-Run Brown TroutFish Over 20 lb
A steppe river running through Tierra del Fuego sheep country that holds the world's largest run of sea-run brown trout, with double-figure fish routine and twenty-pounders taken every season. The season runs from January to April and most water is on private estancias.
Wikipedia Map
Cairns Ribbon Reefs
Queensland
Grander Black MarlinSeptember to December
The outer Ribbon Reefs off Cairns hold the world's most consistent run of giant black marlin, and more fish over 1,000 lb have been taken here than anywhere else. The season is tight — roughly September to December — and boats work from Cairns and Lizard Island.
Wikipedia Map
Daly River
Northern Territory
BarramundiRun-Off Season
A tidal Top End river where barramundi stack at the creek mouths as the wet-season floodwater drains off the floodplain between March and May. Saltwater crocodiles mean the fishing is done from the boat.
Wikipedia Map
Andros
Bahamas
Largest Flats System in the CaribbeanBonefish
The largest island in the Bahamas, fringed by hundreds of square kilometres of hard sand flats and mangrove creeks that hold bonefish in large numbers. The West Side is wilderness fishing reached by skiff from the settlements on the east.
Wikipedia Bahamas Guide Map
Turneffe Atoll
Belize
Grand Slam WaterPermit, Tarpon and Bonefish
A coral atoll 40 kilometres off Belize City whose flats, lagoons and channels hold permit, tarpon and bonefish within a single tide. It is one of the few places where a grand slam is a realistic day's target rather than a career achievement.
Wikipedia Map
Tsimane
Beni
Golden DoradoSight Fishing in Clear Jungle Rivers
Headwater rivers running off the Andes into the Bolivian Amazon, clear enough to sight-fish golden dorado hunting shoals of sábalo. Access is by light aircraft into Tsimane indigenous territory and rod numbers are capped.
Wikipedia Map
Okavango Delta
North-West District
TigerfishCatch-and-Release Season
The Panhandle and main channels of the Okavango hold tigerfish that feed hardest during the September barbel run, when catfish drive baitfish against the papyrus. Fishing is closed each January and February for the spawning season.
Wikipedia Map
Rio Negro
Amazonas
Peacock BassLow-Water Season
A blackwater Amazon tributary whose lagoons and flooded forest hold three-barred and speckled peacock bass, fished from mothership operations in the low-water months from September to March. Water level, not the calendar, decides whether a week fishes well.
Wikipedia Map
Haida Gwaii
British Columbia
Chinook SalmonHalibut Grounds
An archipelago off the northern British Columbia coast where migrating chinook and coho salmon pass close to the headlands through the summer, with halibut on the banks below. Lodges are floating or fly-in and the season runs June to August.
Wikipedia Map
Sal and São Vicente
Cape Verde
Blue MarlinApril to July
Atlantic islands 600 kilometres off Senegal where blue marlin concentrate from April to July, with multiple-fish days common at the peak. The drop-off sits close to shore, so run times are short.
Wikipedia Map
Coyhaique and the Aysén Rivers
Aysén
Brown and Rainbow TroutSpring Creeks and Freestone
The Simpson, Ñireguao and Baker rivers around Coyhaique hold wild brown and rainbow trout in water ranging from meadow spring creek to big glacial freestone. The season runs from November to April.
Wikipedia Map
Quepos
Puntarenas
Pacific SailfishMultiple Raises a Day
A Pacific port with a short run to the offshore seamounts, where sailfish raise in numbers from December to April and marlin follow through the green season. Marina Pez Vela is the base for most of the fleet.
Wikipedia Manuel Antonio Guide Map
Jardines de la Reina
Ciego de Ávila
Marine Park Since 1996Permit and Tarpon
An archipelago 80 kilometres off Cuba's southern coast, protected as a marine park since 1996 and fished by a small licensed rod quota. Permit, tarpon and bonefish share flats that see almost no other traffic.
Wikipedia Map
Iztapa
Escuintla
Highest Sailfish Raise Rate in the World
A Pacific port where the continental shelf and a permanent countercurrent hold sailfish year-round, producing raise counts per boat per day that are the highest recorded anywhere. Peak season runs from November to May.
Wikipedia Map
Laxá í Aðaldal
Northeast Iceland
Atlantic SalmonFly-Only Water
A spring-fed river in northern Iceland known for large, hard-fighting Atlantic salmon in fly-only water, with a season from late June to September. Beats are rotated and rod numbers are strictly limited.
Wikipedia Map
Ramganga River
Uttarakhand
Golden MahseerCatch and Release Only
A Himalayan foothill river along the edge of Corbett National Park holding golden mahseer, fished on a strict catch-and-release basis in the pre-monsoon and post-monsoon windows. Permits are issued through the forest department.
Wikipedia Map
River Moy
County Mayo
Largest Salmon Rod Catch in Ireland
A County Mayo river that produces the highest rod catch of Atlantic salmon in Ireland, with the Ridge Pool running through the middle of Ballina town. Grilse arrive from June and the season closes at the end of September.
Wikipedia Map
Christmas Island
Line Islands
Largest Coral Atoll in the WorldWading Flats
The world's largest coral atoll by land area, ringed by hard sand flats that can be walked for kilometres in ankle-deep water. Bonefish are abundant and giant trevally patrol the outer edges.
Wikipedia Map
Ascension Bay
Quintana Roo
Permit on the FlatsSian Ka'an Biosphere Reserve
A shallow bay inside the Sian Ka'an Biosphere Reserve south of Tulum, holding one of the densest permit populations in the Caribbean along with bonefish, tarpon and snook. Punta Allen is the base and the flats are wadeable.
Wikipedia Map
Cabo San Lucas
Baja California Sur
Striped MarlinYear-Round Fleet
The tip of the Baja peninsula, where the Pacific and the Sea of Cortez meet over deep water within sight of land. Striped marlin are present most of the year and the Bisbee's tournament each October is the richest in the sport.
Wikipedia Los Cabos Guide Map
Eg and Ur Rivers
Khövsgöl
TaimenStrict Rod Quota
Northern Mongolian rivers holding taimen, the largest salmonid in the world, fished on the surface with mouse patterns in September and October. Rod numbers on the protected water are capped by agreement with local communities.
Wikipedia Map
Bazaruto Archipelago
Inhambane
Black MarlinSailfish and Giant Trevally
A chain of dune islands off the Mozambique coast where the shelf drops sharply into the channel, holding black marlin and sailfish within a short run. The flats between the islands add giant trevally and kingfish.
Wikipedia Map
Lake Taupō
Waikato
Rainbow Trout RunsTongariro River
A caldera lake whose feeder rivers, above all the Tongariro, carry rainbow trout upstream to spawn through the winter, giving reliable fishing from May to October. The lake itself is fished by harling and jigging year-round.
Wikipedia Map
Otago and Southland Rivers
Otago and Southland
Sight Fishing to Brown TroutVery Clear Water
Clear South Island rivers — the Clutha, Mataura, Oreti and their tributaries — where large brown trout are spotted individually and cast to one at a time rather than fished blind. The season runs from October to April and most water needs a guide who knows the fish.
Wikipedia Queenstown Guide Map
Lofoten
Nordland
Skrei Cod SeasonJanuary to April
An archipelago inside the Arctic Circle where the migrating skrei cod arrive to spawn between January and April, in the fishery that built the islands' drying racks. Halibut and coalfish are fished through the summer instead.
Wikipedia Map
Sørøya
Finnmark
Atlantic HalibutCod and Coalfish
An Arctic island off Finnmark with deep water close inshore, holding Atlantic halibut over 100 kilos along with cod and coalfish. The midnight sun makes the summer fishing effectively round the clock.
Wikipedia Map
Piñas Bay
Darién
Zane Grey ReefBlack Marlin Records
A bay on Panama's Pacific Darién coast whose offshore seamount, Zane Grey Reef, has produced more world records than any other fishing ground. Black marlin, cubera snapper and roosterfish all sit within a short run.
Wikipedia Map
New Britain
West New Britain
Papuan Black BassTidal Jungle Rivers
Tidal river systems draining rainforest into the Bismarck Sea, holding Papuan black bass — a snapper that lives in fresh water and fights harder for its size than almost anything else. Access is by mothership from Kimbe or Kavieng.
Wikipedia Map
Azores
Azores
Blue MarlinCondor Bank
Mid-Atlantic islands whose offshore seamounts — Condor, Princess Alice and Azores Bank — concentrate blue marlin from July to October, with several fish over 1,000 lb recorded. Horta and Faial are the main bases.
Wikipedia Azores Guide Map
Madeira
Madeira
Grander Blue MarlinDeep Water Off the Cliffs
Deep water sits within a couple of kilometres of the Madeira cliffs, and the island produced a run of blue marlin over 1,000 lb through the 1990s that made its name. The season runs from June to September out of Funchal.
Wikipedia Madeira Guide Map
Alphonse and St François
Outer Islands
Giant TrevallyMilkfish and Triggerfish
An outer-island atoll with a 40-square-kilometre lagoon fished on foot at low water for giant trevally, bonefish, milkfish and triggerfish. Rod numbers are capped and the season splits either side of the monsoon.
Wikipedia Seychelles Guide Map
Astove Atoll
Outer Islands
Wall Drops to 1,000 mGiant Trevally
A remote atoll in the far south of the Seychelles whose reef wall falls away almost vertically a few metres from the flat, so blue-water fish feed within casting range of dry sand. Access is by liveaboard and the rod quota is small.
Wikipedia Seychelles Guide Map
Soča River
Primorska
Marble TroutCatch and Release
A turquoise alpine river holding the endemic marble trout, protected by a strict catch-and-release regime and a limited daily permit. The upper Soča and the Idrijca are the classic beats.
Wikipedia Map
River Ebro
Catalonia and Aragon
Wels Catfish Over 200 lb
The Mequinenza and Riba-roja reservoirs on the Ebro hold wels catfish that regularly exceed 200 lb, along with carp and zander. The fishery runs year-round and is worked from boats and from the bank.
Wikipedia Map
Mafia Island
Pwani
Broadbill SwordfishMarine Park
An island south of Zanzibar with a marine park at its southern end and a channel that holds broadbill swordfish, sailfish and giant trevally. The main billfish season runs from September to March.
Wikipedia Map
River Spey
Moray, Scotland
Spey Casting Named For ItSpring Salmon
A fast Highland river that gave its name to the two-handed casting style developed on it in the nineteenth century. Spring salmon run from February and the river fishes through to the end of September.
Wikipedia Map
River Tweed
Scottish Borders
Autumn Salmon RunLargest Rod Catch in Scotland
A Borders river that produces Scotland's largest annual rod catch of Atlantic salmon, with the run peaking in October and November. Beats are let by the week and most are fished from the bank and by boat.
Wikipedia Map
Bristol Bay
Alaska
Largest Sockeye Run on EarthRainbow Trout Follow the Salmon
The watershed feeding Bristol Bay carries the world's largest sockeye salmon run, and the rainbow trout that follow the spawning fish grow to a size found almost nowhere else. Access to most water is by float plane from Iliamna or King Salmon.
Wikipedia Alaska Guide Map
Cape Cod
Massachusetts
Striped BassFall Run
The Cape's beaches, rips and estuaries hold striped bass and bluefish from May to October, with the autumn run down the outer beach the peak of the season. Monomoy and the Cape Cod Canal are the best-known stretches.
Wikipedia Cape Cod Guide Map
Florida Keys
Florida
Tarpon, Permit and BonefishIslamorada and Key West
The backcountry flats between the Keys and Florida Bay hold the tarpon migration each spring, along with resident permit and bonefish. Islamorada and Key West are the two centres and the fishery is almost entirely catch-and-release.
Wikipedia Florida Keys Guide Map
Kenai River
Alaska
World-Record King SalmonRoad-Accessible
A glacial river south of Anchorage that produced the all-tackle world-record chinook salmon at 97 lb in 1985, and still carries two king runs plus sockeye and silver. Unlike most Alaskan fisheries it is reachable by road.
Wikipedia Alaska Guide Map
Madison River
Montana
Fifty-Mile RiffleSalmonfly Hatch
A Montana freestone river whose long unbroken riffle below Quake Lake gives continuous holding water for wild brown and rainbow trout. The salmonfly hatch in late June and early July is the busiest week of the year.
Wikipedia Yellowstone Guide Map
Venice
Louisiana
Bull RedfishYellowfin Tuna Offshore
The last town on the Mississippi before the delta, with marsh ponds holding bull redfish inshore and the deepwater rigs holding yellowfin tuna a short run offshore. Both fisheries run through the winter.
Wikipedia New Orleans Guide Map
Los Roques
Federal Dependencies
National Park Since 1972Bonefish Flats
A coral archipelago 130 kilometres north of Caracas, protected as a national park since 1972, with white sand flats holding large numbers of bonefish. Fishing is out of the single village on Gran Roque.
Wikipedia Map
Lower Zambezi
Lusaka Province
TigerfishNational Park Frontage
The Zambezi below Kariba runs past a national park, and its channels and rock bars hold tigerfish that take a fly hard and jump repeatedly. September and October are the peak months, at the end of the dry season.
